metadata.title: Finiteness properties of centralisers in $\mathrm{Out}(F_N)$ and automorphisms of free-by-cyclic groups
metadata.abstract: Let $F$ be a finitely generated free group. We prove that the centraliser of any element of $\mathrm{Out}(F)$ or $\mathrm{Aut}(F)$ is of type $\rm{VF}$. We also prove that the (outer) automorphism group of any free-by-cyclic group $M=F\rtimes_\varphi\mathbb{Z}$ is of type $\rm{VF}$, and so are the McCool subgroups of $\mathrm{Out}(M)$. This relies on the construction of a new $\mathrm{Out}(M)$-invariant splitting of $M$, that enables us to reduce the proof of the above statements to the case where the outer class of $\varphi$ has finite order.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 中心化子与自由群半直积的有限性
analysis.workSummary: 有限生成自由群F的Out(F)与Aut(F)任意元素中心化子均为VF型。任意自由群按Z扩张M=F⋊_φ Z的自同构群、外自同构群及Out(M)的McCool子群也为VF型。
analysis.breakthrough: 统一得到中心化子及自由群按Z扩张的多类自同构群的有限型性质。
analysis.limitations: VF表示有有限指数子群具有有限分类空间。摘要陈述覆盖的是所指定群类及其McCool子群。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
